# BareMetalIntrospection v1

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's baremetalintrospection/v1 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.BareMetalIntrospectionV1(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.baremetal_introspection`).

`Introspection.Resources` fetches and lists using the node UUID without assuming Name, Status, or Delete support. `Introspection.WaitUntilFinished(ctx, ref, waitOptions...)` waits for `Finished` and preserves the actual `Error` in `IntrospectionFailureError`. The SDK-owned `StartIntrospection` helper corrects query omission in the pinned native function, forwarding nil/false/true `ManageBoot` and extension queries. See [start, get, and completion waits](introspection/README.md).

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.BareMetalIntrospectionV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Introspection.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
